same as LRN-003 (Three reference parallel gateways (ParallelGateway_2, _3 and _4, plus _6 and _7) are missing, and the generator sequenced the IBAN and BIC tasks and the realm, race and class tasks instead of forking and joining them. The records show parallel joins and splits that the generated model lacks. The trigger generalizes beyond this process to any decision branch whose activities must all be completed. )

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description joins two activities with 'and' (for example, one party performs both actions for the same case) and gives no stated order between them, so both must be completed before the flow continues: Model the two activities as parallel branches: place a parallel gateway split before them and a parallel gateway join after them, so the next step starts only when both branches have completed. Do not model them as a sequence with an arbitrary order, and do not model them as alternatives.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description introduces a set of concurrent work with no order between its parts (for example 'you can start doing two activities' followed by a list), where each part is described as a sequence of several steps, possibly with its own decisions, and a later step is stated to follow only after the concurrent parts have finished

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that the user enters or selects several separate items in one clause, joined by commas or 'and' (for example, a list of choices made for one character or account, or two identifiers entered together), and each item needs its own input or choice: Model each listed item as its own user task, placed in sequence in the order the description gives them. Do not merge the items into one task, and do not drop any listed item.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that the user enters or selects several separate items in one clause, joined by commas or 'and' (for example, a list of choices made for one character or account, or two identifiers entered together), and each item needs its own input or choice

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that two or more sequences of steps are carried out at the same time, where each sequence has several steps in a stated order, and all of these sequences must be finished before a later step begins: Place a parallel gateway split before the first step of each concurrent sequence, with one outgoing branch per sequence. Keep the steps of each sequence in their stated order inside its own branch, and do not interleave steps from different sequences or send them through an exclusive gateway. Close all branches with a parallel gateway join before the later step.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that two or more sequences of steps are carried out at the same time, where each sequence has several steps in a stated order, and all of these sequences must be finished before a later step begins

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description lists three or more activities with no stated order between them, joined by commas and 'and', and all of them must be completed before a later step begins: Model each listed activity as its own task on a separate outgoing branch of one parallel gateway split, and rejoin all branches with a parallel gateway join before the next step. Do not sequence the activities in the order they are listed, and do not use an exclusive gateway for them.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description lists two or more activities joined by 'and' or by commas with no stated order between them, and these activities form the content of one option of a choice (or follow one step), and the flow continues only after all of them are finished
